job.title: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer at Hivaa Services LLC

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot and OCC REST APIs, I design and implement custom commerce extensions, data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM, and lead API migrations. Proven track record in performance tuning, CI/CD deployments on CCv2, and techno-functional collaboration with international stakeholders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer, fluent in English, based in Karlsruhe.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Hivaa Services’ reputation for delivering innovative SAP Commerce solutions to global brands. With over five years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have built and customized high-performance e-commerce platforms that align perfectly with the challenges of this senior role.

bullets.label: Platform Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end backend and frontend features on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) at Rockwell, using Java, Spring and design patterns to meet complex product and pricing requirements.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and integrated PIM-to-Hybris pipelines via Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring seamless data flow between ERP, MDM and storefronts.

bullets.label: Performance & CI/CD
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring and executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, improving response times and enabling reliable cloud releases.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specs, and guide junior developers through production support.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Hivaa Services.

tailoring.why_company: Hivaa Services stands out for its commitment to driving digital transformation through cutting-edge SAP Commerce Cloud implementations for leading enterprises. I admire your focus on scalable, headless architectures and a collaborative culture that empowers engineers to innovate. My deep experience delivering robust Hybris solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell aligns with your mission to create high-performance e-commerce platforms, and I am eager to contribute to your next success story.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Hivaa Services to apply my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise in building scalable, customized e-commerce platforms, and to grow within a team that values innovation and technical excellence.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m interested in the Senior Hybris Developer role at Hivaa Services and would love to discuss how my experience can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer position. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering SAP Commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to Hivaa Services’ success. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my application.
